keySentence: Everything was so strange that Alice asked who she was.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice met a caterpillar. It asked her who she was. Alice did not know anymore. Everything was so strange that Alice asked who she was.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice met a blue caterpillar smoking on top of a mushroom. The caterpillar asked her a simple question about her identity. But Alice could not answer because she had changed so many times. Everything was so strange that Alice asked who she was inside. She had been big, small, and everything in between that day. In Wonderland, even knowing yourself became a great puzzle.
facts.Word cards: asked who = ~가 누구인지 물었다 / so strange = 너무 이상한 / herself = 자기 자신 / wondered = 궁금해했다
